source.notes:
Archive containing the statics, modal and timeseries results (*.csv or *.txt) of package WP2.2 from the OC7 project Phase II.

Load cases included: LC2.1-2.5, LC3.1-3.6, LC4.1, LC5.1-5.2, LC6.1-6.3, LC7.1-7.3

The load cases are defined in the definition document [https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21220820]:
.\01_DEF\OC7_WP2p2_Description_REV12.xlsx

LC2.1 Static Hub Load Check
LC2.2 Static Gravity Load Check
LC2.3 Static Freely Floating Check - linear stiffness in x, y and around z
LC2.4 Static Freely Floating Check - with mooring
LC2.5 Static Current Drag Load - with mooring
LC3.1 Natural Frequency Analysis - unconstrained - Floater only
LC3.2 Natural Frequency Analysis - unconstrained - Floater and WTG
LC3.3a Natural Frequency Analysis - floating in water - with mooring - rigid hull
LC3.3b Natural Frequency Analysis - floating in water - with mooring - flexible hull
LC3.4 Free Decay Surge
LC3.5 Free Decay Heave
LC3.6 Free Decay Pitch
LC4.1 Time Varying RNA Load
LC5.1 Regular Waves - Constrained 
LC5.2 Regular Waves - Freely Floating
LC6.1 Irregular Waves - Waves Only - Constrained
LC6.2 Irregular Waves - Waves Only - Freely Floating
LC6.3 Irregular Waves - Waves + RNA Load - Freely Floating
LC7.1 Irregular Waves - Waves Only - Constrained
LC7.2 Irregular Waves - Waves Only - Freely Floating
LC7.3 Irregular Waves - Waves + RNA Load - Freely Floating
